description: This file defines the Duplicates class, which is part of the PHPOffice PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides functionality for configuring conditional formatting rules related to identifying duplicate or unique values within a specified cell range in a spreadsheet.

classes.name: Duplicates
classes.description: A class that facilitates creating conditional formatting rules for detecting duplicate or unique cell values in a spreadsheet, with methods to configure and instantiate such rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a cell range and an optional inverse flag indicating whether to look for unique or duplicate values.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets the internal inverse flag to invert the logic of the rule.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Returns a Conditional object initialized with the appropriate type (duplicates or unique) and style for this rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Static method to create a Duplicates wizard from an existing Conditional object, extracting the style and other properties.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to allow dynamic calls to 'duplicates' or 'unique' to set the rule's type accordingly.
